p: in those days: When Satan has assailed the Church on the outside, and with little result and in vain, he assails it on the inside, with civil dissension and strife between themselves: but the apostles take occasion by this to set order in the Church.
Grecians against the Hebrews: From among their own members, who became religious Jews from among the Greeks.
daily ministration: In the bestowing of alms according to their need.

Then the twelve called the multitude: The office of preaching the word, and dispensing the goods of the Church, are different from one another, and not rashly to be joined together, as the apostles institute here. And the deacons must seek the consent of the Church more than the apostles.
reason that we should leave the: It is such a matter that we may in no way accept it.
tables: Banquets: though by the name of tables other offices are also meant, which are added to it, such as those which pertain to the care of the poor.
Wherefore: In choosing deacons (and much more in choosing ministers) there must be an examination of both their learning and their manners of life.
Whom they set before the apostles: The ancient Church, with the laying on of hands, as it were consecrated to the Lord those who were lawfully elected.

laid their hands on them: This ceremony of the laying on of hands came from the Jews, who used this ceremony both in public affairs, and in the offering of sacrifices, and also in private prayers and blessings, as appears in Ge 48:13-22; and the Church also observed this ceremony, as is evident from 1Ti 5:22; Ac 8:17. However, there is no mention made here either of cream, or shaving, or razing, or crossing, etc.
And the word of God increased: A happy result of temptation.
faith: This is the figure of speech metonymy, meaning by "faith" the doctrine of the Gospel which brings about faith.

And Stephen: God trains his Church first with evil words and slanders, then with imprisonments, afterwards with scourgings, and by these means prepares it in such a way that at length he causes it to meet in combat with Satan and the world, even to bloodshed and death.
Then there arose certain of the: Schools and universities in ancient times were addicted to false pastors, and were the instruments of Satan to spread abroad and defend false doctrines.
synagogue: Of the people and the school, as it were.
And they were not able to: False teachers, because they will not be overcome, flee from disputations and resort to manifest and open slandering and false accusations.
And they stirred up the people: The first bloody persecution of the Church of Christ, began and sprang from a council of priests, by the suggestion of the university teachers.
And set up false witnesses: An example of frivolous objectors or false accusers, who gather false conclusions from things that are well uttered and spoken.

saw his face as it had: By this it appears that Steven had an excellent and wholesome countenance, having a quiet and settled mind, a good conscience, and certain conviction that his cause was just: for seeing as he was to speak before the people, God beautified his countenance, so that by the very beholding of him the Jews' minds might be penetrated and amazed.
